rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that happens unexpectedly or unusually.

example.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jin4 m4 gei3 dak1 ngo5 sang1 jat6

rows.note: Use this when the surprise carries a stronger sense of disbelief or amazement.

example.jyutping: nei5 geoi1 jin4 haau2 dou2 mun5 fan1

rows.note: Use this concise form mainly in written or more literary wording rather than everyday speech.

example.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jat1 hau2 daap3 jing3
